ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)
notes: The SD card exposes 7 standard on-card registers, read/written by dedicated commands rather than by a memory-mapped offset. They are: OCR, CID, CSD, RCA, DSR, SCR, SSR (SD Status); plus the Card Status Register (CSR) returned within R1 responses.

registers.name: OCR
registers.access: Read (via ACMD41 R3 / CMD58 in SPI)
registers.description: Reports supported VDD voltage windows + card-ready/busy bit + Card Capacity Status (CCS for SDHC/SDXC) + S18A (1.8 V accepted) + XPC + UHS-II support.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Card power-up status; 0 = busy (still initializing), 1 = ready.

fields.name: CCS
fields.description: Card Capacity Status (valid when BUSY=1); 0 = SDSC, 1 = SDHC or SDXC.

fields.name: S18A
fields.description: Switch to 1.8 V accepted; only valid when ACMD41 argument requested S18R=1.

registers.name: CID
registers.access: Read (CMD2 in SD mode, CMD10 thereafter)
registers.description: Factory-programmed (OTP) card identification — Manufacturer ID, OEM/Application ID, product name, product revision, product serial number, manufacturing date, CRC7.

fields.name: MDT
fields.description: Manufacturing Date (4-bit month + 8-bit year offset from 2000).

registers.name: CSD
registers.description: Card characteristics — CSD_STRUCTURE version, TAAC, NSAC, TRAN_SPEED, CCC (command class support), READ_BL_LEN, capacity (C_SIZE / C_SIZE_MULT), write protect, copy / permanent write protect, file format. Two CSD versions: 1.0 (SDSC) and 2.0 (SDHC/SDXC).

fields_csd_v1.name: NSAC
fields_csd_v1.description: Data read access time in CLK cycles (×100).

fields_csd_v2.name: TRAN_SPEED
fields_csd_v2.description: Default Speed = 32h (25 MB/s); High Speed = 5Ah (50 MB/s); higher modes use SSR / Switch Function for UHS.

registers.name: RCA
registers.description: 16-bit local address dynamically assigned by the card during identification. Host uses it as the upper 16 bits of [31:16] argument for addressed commands (CMD7/CMD9/CMD10/CMD13/CMD15).
registers.reset_value: 0x0000 after CMD0; reassigned by next CMD3.

registers.name: DSR
registers.description: Optional register configuring the card's output driver strength for high-fanout buses. Bit 15 = present in CSD; programmed via CMD4.

registers.name: SCR
registers.description: Reports SD physical spec version, security version, supported bus widths, SD Spec3/4/5/X, Extended Security, Command Support Bits.

fields.name: SD_SPEC
fields.description: Physical Layer Spec version (0 = v1.01, 1 = v1.10, 2 = v2.00+).

registers.name: SSR
registers.description: Detailed card status — DAT_BUS_WIDTH, SECURED_MODE, SD_CARD_TYPE, SIZE_OF_PROTECTED_AREA, SPEED_CLASS, PERFORMANCE_MOVE, AU_SIZE, ERASE_SIZE, ERASE_TIMEOUT, ERASE_OFFSET, UHS_SPEED_GRADE, UHS_AU_SIZE, VIDEO_SPEED_CLASS, VSC_AU_SIZE, SUS_ADDR, APP_PERF_CLASS, PERFORMANCE_ENHANCE, CMD_QUEUE_SUPPORT.

registers.name: CSR
registers.description: 32-bit status field embedded in R1/R1b/R6 responses; reports error flags + current state.

fields.name: ERASE_PARAM
fields.description: Invalid selection of write-blocks for erase.

fields.name: WP_VIOLATION
fields.description: Host attempted to write a write-protected block.

fields.name: COM_CRC_ERROR
fields.description: CRC of the previous command failed.

fields.name: ILLEGAL_COMMAND
fields.description: Command not legal in current state.

fields.name: CSD_OVERWRITE
fields.description: CMD27 attempt to overwrite read-only CSD section.

fields.name: WP_ERASE_SKIP
fields.description: Set when only partial address range erased due to WP.

fields.name: READY_FOR_DATA
fields.description: Buffer empty / ready for next data block.

fields.name: APP_CMD
fields.description: Card was expected to interpret following command as ACMD (set after CMD55).
